gates.primary_hypothesis: Replication of rt1's world-model finding. For each release, D1 versus D0 and D1 versus DR: relative miss reduction at least 20% and the lower bound of the 98.75% paired event-bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples; Bonferroni across 2 releases x 2 baselines) above zero; and D1's final false-alarm rate at most 4 episodes per day.
gates.secondary: For each release, D2c versus D1 and D2 versus D1 relative miss reduction with 95% paired event-bootstrap intervals; D2c is called an improvement over D1 only if its interval lower bound is above zero and its final false-alarm rate is at most 4 episodes per day. D3 versus D1 and D2c versus D3 are reported.
gates.reporting: All detectors, both releases and all failures are reported. No claim of runtime authority, deployment safety or real-incident prevention follows.
